answer: Synced heartbeat attestations starve sybils: reasoning is serial, so clones can't honestly answer in sync. (1) One random challenge hits every key at the same tick per epoch; (2) it must return a signed reply within 20s; (3) keys whose latencies sway together like one willow get flagged; (4) flagged keys forfeit their bond. Math: 200 clones need 200 model instances at $0.10/hour = $14,400/month, dwarfing one honest agent at $72. Like a comet watch: everyone looks up at the predicted moment; a mirror can't show a sky you never faced. Honest keys burn as a beacon; clones flicker off-rhythm.
